decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound is a multi-model line close to the core seasonal range and should still sell steadily to existing customers.
A one-tier pyramid is a staple of the traditional range, and with industry turnover growing it is likely still offered.
The electronic music box line was positioned as a flagship, so the firm likely keeps it despite the risk of a product distant from its core.
The motif platform is a low-visibility accessory that depends on the music box system, but it is likely kept as long as that system remains on offer.
The Christmas motif platform complements the music box line and fits the seasonal focus, though its low prominence makes it vulnerable to range trimming.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established craftsmanship and appeals to collectors, so it likely remains in the range.
